FAILURE MODE: capacity-limited -- epochs are at the budget ceiling and lr is tuned (8e-4 best), yet hr=0.566 is still well below the old uncapped champion ~0.90 which used wider proximals (hidden 64). HYPOTHESIS: if I widen the proximal CNN hidden 32->48, expect hr above 0.5663 because the proximal blocks are now the bottleneck (lr/epochs already tuned) and wider convs fit breast mu-structure better; chose 48 not 64 to keep wall under the 30-min SLURM ceiling (iter-3 was 1517s at h32).
